doc: Land only in the north: asymmetry 1.0, raw shift 0.83 x phi_H, clipped to +0.35 x phi_H (the upper clip), Hadley edge 30: 10.5 deg. 1e-9. Output `shift_deg` is 0-d: shape [] in case.json, one item of data.bin. params.constants lists the module constants and the inline numbers the function reads (a port copies them from its own source and may assert that they equal these).
